command: openclaw gateway --port 19099 --force --allow-unconfigured, one `openclaw agent --agent main` turn, then SIGTERM
note: The real presence pair, with the gatewayPort the daemon identity keys on. The plugin registers four MORE hooks (session_start/session_end/before_agent_run/agent_end) and none fired: `openclaw agent` does not open a session on the hooked path, and all six names still exist in 2026.7.1 — so this is flow coverage, not drift. The composed gateway_lifecycle keeps those arms. The turn also spawned a Claude Code backend whose OWN hooks reached the recorder through the inherited PIXTUOID_SOCKET; they are filtered out here, since a fixture holding another CLI's wire is fiction.
